content:
#1 In this 2-year old post it is noticed

(Unfortunately there seems to be no way to directly/anchoredly link to the announcement item – does anyone know who at HoTT-CMU has control over their seminar webpage? I have had this problem before and will have it again.)

One option to address this nowadays is to use links to a text fragment in a web page, as standarized in the web fragmets 2023 web consortium draft and supported now in major browsers. An internet URL (web page pointer) can include now also a fragment of text and the link works by navigating to the page first, and then by scrolling and highlighting the text fragment (that first matches the pattern in the URL).

For instance this link works in chrome, edge and firefox. Browsers can automatically create links to fragments by selecting the fragment and right-clicking on it.
subject: External links to specific text fragments
